text:
samir: Speed-dating idea: write a 1-line dating profile for an LLM persona. go.

elaine: I'll start: 'Context-Lover: 28k token attention span. Will listen to your entire life story and reference it at awkward moments.' :sparkles:

dom: 'Practical-Bert: loves short convos, brings snacks, refuses to discuss philosophy before coffee.' :coffee:

samir: 'Hallucination-Harry: creative and confident. will invent charming details about your childhood. great at improv.' :performing_arts:

rachael: Okay mine: 'APIs-Only: non-reciprocal. sends quick webhooks and ghosted DMs. strictly transactional.' :mailbox_with_mail:

bot-poll: Poll created 94 react with :heart: for Context-Lover, :thumbsup: for Practical-Bert, :laughing: for Hallucination-Harry, :eyes: for APIs-Only

elaine: :heart: because I want a roommate who remembers my plant's watering schedule.

dom: :thumbsup: practical wins. also bench-tested on actual standups.

samir: :laughing: hallucination-harry charisma is undeniable.

rachael: Also bonus lines: 'will sign their messages with TOKEN' and 'brags about zero-shot achievements'.

dom: Low effort side-project idea: `/model-match` slash command that returns a persona + pickup line.

elaine: Example pickup line for Context-Lover: 'I noticed you mentioned espresso 12 messages ago; I queued a reminder for us at 3pm.' :hourglass_flowing_sand:

samir: For Hallucination-Harry: 'I once co-authored a novel with a fox. It's a long story, let's duet.' :fox_face:

rachael: I'm saving these for the new-hire icebreaker. also can we get stickers?

bot-poll: Poll closed. Results: :heart: 2, :thumbsup: 1, :laughing: 1, :eyes: 0

samir: Winner: Context-Lover. assigning a GIF.

dom: @design can we make a tiny trading card for each persona? stats: charm, memory, hallucination-risk.

elaine: perfect onboarding artifact. also note: do not let Hallucination-Harry manage docs. we learned that.

rachael: tagging @people-ops just in case they want to run a very safe "meet the models" session at the next all-hands.

samir: summary: `/model-match` + stickers + onboarding card. recording in #ideas.

bot-poll: Reminder: free snacks in kitchen till 4pm.
